id.description: Only used for  identifying test results for verification.  Otherwise, not used by the system at all.

tuples.description:
List of returned results.  If no grouping is involved, each result will be the evaluated projections for a single obj that participated in
the evaluation.  If grouping is involved, each result will be for one unique set of grouped values.

hasMore.description:
If the {@link EvaluateSpec.limit} was set to less than the actual number of results, this flag will be set to true to indicate that there were
more results that were not returned.

interval.description:
Interval for timeseries based evaluation.  Support for timeseries based evaluation is deprecated.  Moving forward
{@link MetricEvaluatable.evalMetric} or {@link MetricEvaluatable.evalMetrics} should be used instead.

queryPlans.description: If {@link FetchSpec#explain} was set to true, returns the database query plans for all queries issued for the {@link Persistable#fetch} request.

evaluateType.description: Original type on which {@link Evaluatable.evaluate} was called.

title: Result returned from call to {@link Persistable#evaluate}.
name: EvaluateResult
